name: Sundering Chop
textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage and {poiseDamage} Poise damage. Draw {draw} card.
flavor:
Downward blow meant to split a shield.

The Vanguard's smiths measured their work by it. A shield that survived three chops was sent to the wall; one that did not was sent back to the forge with the smith's name chalked upon it.

Few names were chalked twice.
